Package org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.logicprogrammer

Record Class ParameterChipLayout

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.logicprogrammer.ParameterChipLayout
Record Components:
chips - The x, y and width of the chip of each shown parameter, which are the first ones.
more - The x, y and width of the chip of the parameters that are left out, or null if all are shown.
button - The x, y and width of the button to add a parameter.
public record ParameterChipLayout(List<int[]> chips, @Nullable int[] more, int[] button) extends Record
The places of the parameter chips in the expression panel: in rows, followed by the button to add a parameter.

    • layout

      public static ParameterChipLayout layout(int[] chipWidths, IntUnaryOperator moreWidth, int buttonWidth, int x, int y, int width, int rowHeight, int rows)
      Parameters:
      chipWidths - The width of the chip of each parameter.
      moreWidth - The width of the chip of the parameters that are left out, by how many there are.
      buttonWidth - The width of the button to add a parameter.
      x - The left of the rows.
      y - The top of the first row.
      width - The width of the rows.
      rowHeight - The distance between the tops of two rows.
      rows - The most rows.
      Returns:
      The layout.
